title: Citus: re-join a removed Patroni member
description: Runs `nexus scale-out add citus --role replica`: finds a provisioned-but-stopped PG member, starts nexus-patroni, waits for it to reach streaming. Genuine shard growth (a 3rd worker group + citus_add_node + rebalance_table_shards) is apply-on-demand.

observe.what: citus-worker1-1 rejoined Patroni group citus-worker1 (streaming) in ~4.5s

whatProves: CitusAdapter.ScaleOutAddAsync brings a stopped PG member back up so Patroni re-streams it (apply-on-demand for a genuine new worker group, ADR-0042: provision VMs + citus_add_node + rebalance_table_shards).
